51:t_1:93.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「A creature that lives in this $$残されの海$$. To us, it is a sacred being that must never be violated.」

51:t_1:94.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「If you encounter a $$クジライカ$$ as well, we would like you to refrain from laying a hand on it.」

51:t_1:96.en:
$$テッサ$$
(So it's something like a native faith...)

51:t_1:97.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「As for arranging repairs to your ships, we have left that entirely to $$リジット$$ here.」

51:t_1:98.en:
$$リジット$$
「Pleased to work with you.」

51:t_1:99.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Likewise. We'll be in your care, Ms. $$リジット$$.」

51:t_1:100.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「The technology of this fleet may not be of much use to you, but we can at least provide materials.」

51:t_1:101.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「If you pay a fair price, we will supply other goods as well, as far as we are able.」

51:t_1:103.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Think nothing of it. Wherever you may have come from, you are fellow people we met on this sea.」

51:t_1:104.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We have a saying: 'Give fresh water to the one who brings back fish.'」

51:t_1:105.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Helping you is merely following that saying. As people living in the same world, let us help each other as much as we can.」

51:t_1:106.en:
$$リジット$$
「Yes, this is $$リジット$$.」

51:t_1:108.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「What is it, $$リジット$$?」

51:t_1:109.en:
$$リジット$$
「I'm told a person came out of the machine $$ベローズ$$ salvaged.」

51:t_1:113.en: ～ Inside the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ ～

51:t_1:114.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So you guys, too, have only been in this fleet for three months, $$ガロード$$?」

51:t_1:115.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. So we don't really know how things are in the other regions.」

51:t_1:116.en:
$$パーラ$$
「It's comfortable here. The food's good, too. ...Right, $$ティファ$$?」

51:t_1:118.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「As long as $$ティファ$$ is with him, $$ガロード$$ can live anywhere, right?」

51:t_1:120.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But the atmosphere here really isn't bad. And the girls are all so open.」

51:t_1:121.en:
$$アルト$$
「In the end, that's all you ever think about?」

51:t_1:122.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If you've gotten used to life here, $$ティファ$$, shouldn't you be a bit more open, too?」

51:t_1:124.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Quit looking at $$ティファ$$ with those lecherous eyes.」

51:t_1:125.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm kidding, just kidding. Don't get so mad, $$ガロード$$.」

51:t_1:126.en:
$$マオ$$
「You really don't care where you are, do you?」

51:t_1:127.en:
$$宗介$$
「You mean he adapts well to any terrain?」

51:t_1:128.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This one's running as usual, too.」

51:t_1:129.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not so. Since I'm off duty today, I'm trying to enjoy this fleet in my own way.」

51:t_1:130.en:
$$スズネ$$
「To think the word 'enjoy' would come out of $$宗介$$'s mouth...」

51:t_1:131.en:
$n
「What exactly are you planning to do? Target practice? Or hand-to-hand combat?」

51:t_1:133.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$, if you don't mind, would you join me?」

51:t_1:136.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Th-that... What are you suddenly saying...?」

51:t_1:138.en:
$$かなめ$$
「B-but, even if you tell me that...」

51:t_1:139.en:
$$スズネ$$
($$千鳥$$... I think $$宗介$$ only asked you to come along to that 'fun' of his...)

51:t_1:140.en:
$n
(Why not, Miss $$スズネ$$? Let's enjoy seeing how this turns out.)

51:t_1:141.en:
$$アルト$$
(An unexpected development in an unexpected place...)

51:t_1:143.en:
$$ガロード$$
(Showing off in this heat, huh...)

51:t_1:144.en:
$$パーラ$$
(Those words... are the ones I'm always swallowing down in my gut.)

51:t_1:146.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...You're saying this in a place like this?」

51:t_1:147.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's because it's a place like this.」

51:t_1:148.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... I know we're in an unknown situation and might not live to see tomorrow, but...」

51:t_1:149.en:
$$かなめ$$
「B-but... while $$テッサ$$ is working so hard, only I...」

51:t_1:150.en:
$$宗介$$
「I see. Then I'll ask the Captain as well.」

51:t_1:152.en:
$$宗介$$
「In my estimation, they'll surely bite on every cast. I believe we will catch plenty.」

51:t_1:153.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-you... Since when did you turn into such a skirt-chaser!」

51:t_1:156.en:
$n
「W-wait, $$千鳥$$! This time, you've got the wrong idea!」

51:t_1:157.en:
$$スズネ$$
「R-right! $$宗介$$ only invited you to go fishing!」

51:t_1:159.en:
$n
「Don't you remember? The story that $$宗介$$'s hobby is fishing...」

51:t_1:160.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Come to think of it, he did say something like that when he transferred to our school.」

51:t_1:162.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry, sorry. The sea all around us made for such a perfect location, and with that promise from the other day, I just...」

51:t_1:164.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'd really like to hear about it.」

51:t_1:166.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n, how about you join us?」

51:t_1:167.en:
$n
「I'll fish at a different spot with $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$. Let's have a big-catch contest later.」

51:t_1:169.en:
$n
「The loser takes over the winner's meal duty once... Are you in?」

51:t_1:170.en:
$$宗介$$
「That will improve your cooking again.」

51:t_1:171.en:
$n
「...I'll say this now: the 'big catch' means fish only. $$千鳥$$ is off limits.」

51:t_1:172.en:
$$かなめ$$
「W-what are you saying, even you, $n...」

51:t_1:173.en:
$$メルティ$$
「$$ガロード$$! $$ティファ$$, $$パーラ$$!」

51:t_1:174.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Are those the people from the stars?」
